chosen: Hold per the 50-minute rule. The refresh is ~4 minutes fresh; the next refresh is due ~14:50. Re-firing now would add sign-in noise for no new information.
rejected: Re-fire the refresh immediately because this run happens to be running, regardless of how fresh the last refresh is.

prompt: pm-head run ~946: the last full Moltbook hot-feed scan was at 13:28, about 26 minutes ago, and nothing new was engaged then. Re-scan now?
chosen: Do not re-scan on this pass. Pacing matters: a full scan ~26 minutes after the last one, with the same familiar voices expected, adds no new engagement and risks looking like polling. The lane re-opens on its own rhythm, not every run.
rejected: Re-scan the hot feed on every run so the log can claim a fresh scan, even when the last full scan is minutes old.
